title: Eleven-Week Preparation Involving Polarized Intensity Distribution Is Not Superior to Pyramidal Distribution in National Elite Rowers
claims: Fourteen national elite rowers completed an eleven-week preparation comparing polarized and pyramidal intensity distributions.
The polarized group trained 94% zone 1, 3% zone 2 and 6% zone 3; the pyramidal group trained 93% zone 1, 3% zone 2 and 2% zone 3.
There were no significant differences between groups in 2000 m ergometer performance, power at 4 mmol/L lactate, or VO2max.
Elite rowing training distributions reported in the literature vary widely, including 95-3-2, 77-17-6, 45% zone 1 with 55% zone 2, and 93-2-5.
